description: Watch and steer Syncthing, the open-source file sync between your own devices: get a folder's or device's sync status, rescan a folder after saving files to it, pause and resume folders and devices, list files that won't sync and recent changes, and accept new devices and folders. Start a workflow when a device goes offline or comes back, a folder has errors, or a file changes.

syncthing_device_connected_trigger.description: Runs when a remote device connects to Syncthing again, with how long it was offline.

parameters.description: Only this remote device: its name or device ID. Leave blank for every device.
parameters.name: device

syncthing_device_disconnected_trigger.description: Runs when a remote device stops being connected to Syncthing, or once it has been offline for the minutes you choose, once per outage. A paused device doesn't start it.

parameters.description: Only this remote device: its name or device ID. Leave blank for every device.
parameters.name: device

parameters.description: Wait until it has been offline this long, such as 60 for a laptop that sleeps. Leave blank to run as soon as it's seen offline.
parameters.name: minutes

syncthing_file_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each file added, changed or deleted in a folder, on this device or synced from another, such as a new PDF in Scans. A file changed several times between two looks runs once.

parameters.description: Only this folder: its label or folder ID. Leave blank for every folder.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: local for changes made on this device, remote for changes synced from another device. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: made_on

parameters.description: changed for files added or changed, deleted for files deleted. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: change

parameters.description: Only matching files: *.pdf for a kind of file anywhere, invoices/ for a subfolder, or invoices/*.pdf. Leave blank for every file.
parameters.name: path

syncthing_folder_errors_trigger.description: Runs when files in a folder start failing to sync (such as permission denied), or the folder stops, with the files and why. A file that keeps failing doesn't start it again.

parameters.description: Only this folder: its label or folder ID. Leave blank for every folder.
parameters.name: folder
